limitations: No comprehensive audiovisual or board audit
Conventional gas-only pressure-work examples require declared transient damping/boundary accounting
Endpoint-matched irreversible isothermal example does not assert a uniform constant gas temperature during its transient
Adiabatic paths to the same final pressure have different complete endpoints
Entropy balance is previewed through an exact ideal-gas state-function expression; formal interpretation follows next chapter
